title: Kyvos Failures by Cube
app: Kyvos OLAP engine query logs and the Kyvos REST API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=kyvos:query status="ERROR"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by cube_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Kyvos failures grouped by cube so operators immediately see which specific cubes are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Kyvos is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Kyvos failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical cubes.
visualization: Table of cube by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Kyvos are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
